info.title: ONESOURCE Trust Tax Services - V2
info.description: ONESOURCE Trust Tax is a comprehensive and integrated web application that automates the trust tax process from the initial bridging of trust accounting data to the final print and filing of completed tax returns. Our selection of RESTful APIs allows authenticated ONESOURCE Trust Tax users direct access to specified functions within the ONESOURCE Trust Tax application. For example, the Account APIs allow authenticated ONESOURCE Trust Tax users to retrieve a paginated list of Product Access Numbers (PANs), or to retrieve a paginated list of accounts in the current tax year or any of the four prior tax years for a specific PAN. The Partnership Schedule K1 APIs allow for retrieving the import status for a partnership K-1 or importing partnership K-1 amounts into ONESOURCE Trust Tax.
